issue.body:
When `@requires` decorator is used along with `@app.route`, their order matters. Wrong order causes lack of authorization check.

I am using Starlette `0.13.2`

**Works correctly:**
```python
@app.route("/data", methods=["GET"])
@requires("authenticated")
async def data(request):
    # ...
```
**Doesn't work (allows unauthorized access):**
```python
@requires("authenticated")
@app.route("/data", methods=["GET"])
async def data(request):
   # ...
```

I am not sure if this is something that can be easily fixed. If not maybe it should be marked as warning in documentation.
issue.title: @requires with @app.route order matters
